search_queries: targeted PyPI and project-documentation lookups for nine named XML parsers
uncertainty: Five verified third-party paths (lxml, beautifulsoup4, defusedxml, xmltodict and untangle) are selected from nine named PyPI/project-documentation leads. A bounded PyPI Simple Index search remains pending; 4 leads are unresolved, so this is not a completed top-ten ranking. lxml uses source-built libxml2 2.15.4; beautifulsoup4's documented 'xml' builder runs on the same lxml 6.1.3/libxml2 2.15.4 pins (shared parser family, no independent XML tokenizer, recover=True); xmltodict, defusedxml (guarded pure-Python ElementTree XMLParser), untangle (SAX via defusedxml's DefusedExpatParser) and the standard ElementTree path use Expat. defusedxml is a guard facade over CPython ElementTree, not an independent XML engine; its own code is constant on the valid controls, and ElementTree keeps no xmlns declarations, so its comparison with the lxml oracle omits the declaration count. untangle runs SAX without namespace processing and drops namespace URIs; its controls are checked against an lxml oracle projected to untangle's qualified-name view, not against namespace-expanded names. The lxml, beautifulsoup4, defusedxml and untangle controls exercise valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 namespace structures without DOCTYPE, not full XML conformance. PyPI Stats package downloads are not XML-specific use; Beautiful Soup downloads are mostly HTML use, and defusedxml downloads are largely transitive. lxml and beautifulsoup4 AFL feedback excludes parser.c lines 8700-8720 because address-sensitive attribute hash lookups varied across identical valid replays.
